column1: # screen field batch 5: BaseMenuScreen - the animated menu shell every menu screen shares.
# render() pins the animation state: backgroundPlates (e, the eight 752x447 plates scrolled by the
# frame delta and wrapped at 2048), floatingImages (h) with floatingMotion (i, one {speed, startX,
# wrapX} row each, flipping sign when the image reaches the wrap point), curtainImages (g, the
# fifteen narrow 30x144 strips) and logoImage (f, the 273x273 market-dependent logo). lastFrameTime
# (b) is the delta clock render() computes; showTime (a) is stamped by show() and only ever copied -
# nothing reads it, so it keeps that neutral name.
# The three renderers/containers are named by their root widget: backgroundRenderer (d, the parallax
# scene), hudRenderer (j, the widget tree the input is dispatched to), menuContainer (k), the
# Back/Exit button container (l) with its white backLabel (m) and offset black backLabelShadow (n),
# the per-screen contentContainer (s) that createContent() fills, and the four dialog items built by
# createMenuItemContainer: websiteItem (p, hidden for ChinaMobile/iWin/JoyMoa), forumItem (q, hidden
# for ChinaMobile/iWin), purchaseItem (r, shown when the license is purchasable) and unusedMenuItem
# (o, a null-text item that is created and then only ever hidden).
# Listening/state members: active (c, cleared on the parent when a child screen takes over and the
# only thing pause() checks), wasTouchDown (t, the previous frame's press), menuActionListener (u),
# dialogListener (y), nextScreen (v), pendingAction (w), messageDialog (x) - the last three are
# exactly what the synthetic accessors setNextScreen/getMessageDialog/getPendingAction expose - and
# the shared in-menu musicPlaylist (z) that render() updates and pause() disposes.
